seedTimeLimitHint.message: Optional browser-side rules with a separate hour limit per tracker hostname. Saving another tracker does not replace existing rules. Counts Transmission's cumulative seeding time, including seeding without upload traffic, not time since adding the torrent. The tracker's credited time may differ. Chrome must be running; the popup may be closed. Disabled by default.

seedTimeLimitEnabled.message: Enable seed time limit for the selected tracker

seedTimeLimitChooseTracker.message: Choose a tracker from existing torrents

seedTimeLimitIncludeExisting.message: Also apply to existing torrents (off by default)

seedTimeLimitSafety.message: Only completed seeding or seed-queued torrents are stopped; nothing is deleted. Every tracker on a torrent must have the selected hostname. Malformed or mixed-host tracker lists are skipped. Existing torrents are excluded unless explicitly included. Checks run at most once per minute, on normal polling; sleep and background scheduling may delay stopping. Manually restarting a limited torrent does not exempt it. Restored backups require reactivation.

scriptSettingsHint.message: These are optional server-side scripts run by Transmission, not Chrome. In Docker, enter the path inside the container; the file must exist and be executable by the Transmission user. Leave disabled if you do not use a custom script. In Transmission 4.0.6, the seeding-completed event is triggered by the daemon’s own ratio or idle limit, not the extension’s seed-time limit or manual pausing.
